subject: Urgent: BlueHarbor runtime spike — log access & retention Qs
messages:
From: Martha Simms <martha.simms@blueharbor.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@blueharbor.com
Date: 2027-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: High error rate + tail latency this morning — need logs and retention details

Aisha —

Today between ~08:40 and 09:15 PT we saw a sharp increase in 95th/99th percentile latency and elevated 500s. Our engineers captured a short trace and request IDs (attached as request_ids_1245.csv). Can you confirm:

- What log sources you can provide for this window (request traces, runtime logs, node metrics)?
- Current retention windows for each type (how long request-level traces persist)?
- Whether you can produce a chain-of-custody for exported logs (S3 export/archive) for compliance?

BlueHarbor is preparing an internal exec note and legal wants to know what we can expect to receive and the timeframe. Please mark urgent.

Thanks,
Martha Simms
Head of Ops — BlueHarbor Financial

Attachment: request_ids_1245.csv (csv, 7kb)

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Martha Simms <martha.simms@blueharbor.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + tail latency this morning — need logs and retention details

Martha — thanks for the heads up and for the request IDs. We’re treating this as high priority. Quick answers up front:

- We can provide request-level traces (sampling-dependent), node/runtime logs, and aggregated token-level metrics for the timeframe you specified.
- Default retention: request traces (14 days), runtime logs (30 days), metrics (90 days). If you have a contract-specific retention requirement we can escalate.
- We can produce an export bundle and include a simple chain-of-custody manifest (who pulled what and timestamps). For formal legal requests we follow our evidence-handling workflow and will work with security/legal to produce signed manifests.

I’ve looped in Dylan (SRE) to pull the trace exports and Markus (VP) since this has exec attention. Neha (Security) — can you confirm the minimal redaction steps before we hand anything off to BlueHarbor?

I will aim to share a preview (spike_preview.json) within 2 hours and an export bundle within 8 business hours. If that schedule doesn’t work, tell me what you need.

—Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Account Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachment: runtime_spike_20270630.log (preview, 120kb)

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + tail latency this morning — need logs and retention details

Aisha — collecting now. Notes for the record / internal handoff:

- Time window: 2027-06-30T08:40:00-2027-06-30T09:15:00 PT
- Pulling request traces for IDs in request_ids_1245.csv (may be sampled; will flag missing ones).
- Export targets: secure S3 bucket: s3://evidence-exports/blueharbor/2027-06-30/ (objects: spike_bundle_20270630.tar.gz, manifest_spike_20270630.json).
- Will include system-level runtime logs from the serving fleet (nodes a1-a6), kernel errors, and aggregator metrics.
- ETA: preview JSON in ~45 minutes; full encrypted bundle upload in ~6 hours (will notify with presigned link).

Attachment: spike_preview.json (JSON, 48kb) — contains redacted traces and sample latency histogram.

Action items for Security/Legal: please advise on redaction script (remove PII, full user prompts) and whether we need to produce an access log (who retrieved the S3 objects and when) as part of the manifest.

—Dylan (SRE)

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + tail latency this morning — need logs and retention details

Team —

Thanks for the quick pull. Security guidance for evidence handoff to a customer:

1) Minimum redactions: remove any literal user input (prompts/answers), obfuscate IP addresses to /24, and strip full session keys. Keep request IDs and timing metadata intact.
2) Produce a manifest (manifest_spike_20270630.json) that lists exported files, generation time, hashes (SHA256), and the operator who performed the export.
3) Chain-of-custody: include an access_log.csv with S3 presigned URL creation timestamps and the internal accounts used to create them.
4) For exec/legal: provide a one‑page summary that lists what was shared, retention windows, and next steps.

I’m attaching our internal evidence_handling_checklist.pdf; follow it for the export and route the encrypted bundle through our DLP-approved bucket. If legal/BlueHarbor needs more (e.g., signed affidavit), we will coordinate with Legal.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Security Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_handling_checklist.pdf (pdf, 22kb)

From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, martha.simms@blueharbor.com
Date: 2027-06-30T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High error rate + tail latency this morning — export link (preview)

Martha / Aisha —

Preview uploaded: https://internal-downloads.redwood/evidence/preview/spike_preview_20270630.json (link for BlueHarbor only).
Full export plan: spike_bundle_20270630.tar.gz (encrypted) + manifest_spike_20270630.json + access_log.csv will be uploaded to s3://evidence-exports/blueharbor/2027-06-30/. I will create a presigned GET link and post it here once the upload completes.

Note: a small subset of request IDs from request_ids_1245.csv were not found due to sampling; I’ve noted those in manifest_spike_20270630.json. If BlueHarbor requires unsampled traces we can discuss a targeted re-ingest with product/legal sign-off.

—Dylan

Aisha / Team —

Thank you — the preview looks helpful. Two quick asks from our side so execs can close the loop:

1) Can you provide the expected timeframe to get the full encrypted bundle and manifest (we see 6 hours from Dylan, can you confirm)?
2) Please produce the one-page exec summary (what was shared, retention windows, and answer on chain-of-custody) so we can attach it to our incident report.

We appreciate the rapid turnaround. If you can ping me the presigned link as soon as it’s available that would be ideal.

Best,
Martha
